difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for the contraction of an exceptional curve of the first kind the Picard groups fit into a split short exact sequence whose middle map is the restriction of the degree to the curve and whose splitting twists by multiples of the curve (statement lines 4776-4788). The proof (proof lines 4790-4836) identifies the last map with restriction to the curve, shows that the pullback is an isomorphism onto the sheaves restricting trivially, shows that the pushforward inverts it after reducing by flat base change to a regular local base, and exhibits the splitting. H2: a two-claim argument with a flat base change reduction, written out in full.
